inputs.text: They’re making Terry Pheto the face of an alleged R20.56 million National Lotteries Commission scandal, and that feels less like transparency than a carefully managed distraction. The claims surfaced at the Portfolio Committee on Trade, Industry and Competition on Tuesday, 24 March 2026, but a briefing and an SIU probe are still institutions telling the public what they want it to hear. If everyone keeps steering attention toward one person, the real question is who benefits from keeping the institutions—and whatever they may be hiding—out of focus.
